mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns on average.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month CPI inflation rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% and industrial production falls below 105.0, recession fears drive negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0 AND INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months), S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative due to policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 2000.0 (thousands of units) indicate strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When CPI inflation exceeds 2.0% annually and payroll employment growth falls below 0.5% monthly, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 60-day returns due to stagflation fears.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2.0% AND PAYEMS growth < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply shock (INDPRO below 105.0), S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative due to reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.
